name: Klenčí pod Čerchovem (Czechia)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over green, with a white stockade of pointed stakes with a central post across the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 February 1998 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
